summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by VersaBank, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting a press release dated May 29, 2026, announcing that founder and president David Taylor was named 'Executive of the Year' by the Canadian Lenders Association. The filing is a routine award announcement and does not involve any corporate transaction, strategic review, or management change beyond recognition. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics are present. This is not a special situation.
